checks.Title: Seduce, don't just observe
checks.Evidence: The prose is dense with fascinating strangeness — the drain running the wrong direction, the volt rats, the lowercase 'yes' — but the sensory pull is buried under long stretches of procedural/invoice logistics, bureaucratic vocabulary, and financial itemization that reads more like worldbuilding infrastructure than seduction; the reader has to wade through invoices and clearance-code mechanics for a long time before the strange-beautiful textures (the lake reading differently by observer position, the eleven days with no name) land.
checks.Fix: Trim or compress the invoice/paperwork passages and foreground the uncanny sensory details (the calm children, the drain metaphor, the mismatched lake reflections) earlier and more often so allure consistently precedes and outweighs procedural exposition.

checks.Title: Open with the world doing its work
checks.Evidence: The opening beat (Elias eating at his desk) is compressed into a single paragraph before the plot device — a work order and a sealed corridor number — arrives at 7:14 and dominates every paragraph after; there is no unhurried commute, transaction, or lived-in city moment that isn't already in service of the mystery.
checks.Fix: Extend the opening beat into a genuine grounded routine (the broth, the apartment, the building's history, the street he can't reach) for several beats before the work order lands, so the reader falls into the world before being handed the inciting document.

checks.Title: Gloss first mentions in-voice, never dump
checks.Evidence: Terms like 'CorpoNations,' 'Channeler,' and 'GLMZ' get quick in-voice glosses ('the corporate-state paperwork that passes for a building code up here'; 'someone who rents out his own nervous system to an unlicensed AI and lets it drive'), but 'neuretics' is only glossed once, in passing, deep into an already-dense paragraph ('the mesh grown into anyone who can afford the surgery, his own trusted more than paper'), and by the time terms like 'Φ,' 'Attendance incident,' 'Resonance Management Authority,' or 'AAMA filings' appear, they arrive with no gloss at all, assuming the reader already tracks the currency symbol and acronyms.
checks.Fix: Add a brief in-voice touch the first time Φ, the Attendance incident, and AAMA are used, so a first-time reader isn't left to infer currency and lore purely from context clues buried in unrelated sentences.

checks.Title: Never an acronym before its term
checks.Evidence: GLMZ (Great Lakes Metropolitan Zone's Orbital Debris Registry) and ArcSec ('Arcturus's security arm') are properly glossed at first use, but AAMA appears bare — 'in three AAMA filings she could pull herself' — with no prior expansion anywhere in the text.
checks.Fix: Expand AAMA at its first appearance, e.g. 'the Anomalous Activity Management Authority — AAMA — filings she could pull herself.'

checks.Title: Give the POV character one human crack
checks.Evidence: The hands-going-cold moment ('He notices his hands have gone cold... watches them not quite steady, the way you'd watch a gauge you didn't trust') and later the fourteen-second wait for the AI's answer where he registers 'wanting the answer anyway — wanting it enough that he noticed, standing there, that he wanted it' both puncture his controlled, ledger-reading register with a flash of unguarded human need.

checks.Title: Land one beat past the handoff
checks.Evidence: The ending resolves into an active, forward-moving decision loop (clearing the rate field, leaving it OPEN, 'he began to work') rather than a single quiet gesture after the plot's business concludes; it reads as a continuation/setup for the next installment, not a landing.
checks.Fix: Cut the final page down to one small, concrete physical gesture (e.g., the coat, the window, the pigeon note) and end there, letting the open rate field and the six coordinates stay unresolved off-page so a cold reader feels weight and closure rather than an ongoing operational thread.

checks.Title: Reward re-reading without requiring it
checks.Evidence: Small first-pass-legible details are seeded to pay off later without gating comprehension: the pill case ('Three segments left... Refill: open, no due date') reads as a minor character tic on first read but recontextualizes once the story's themes of dependency and open-ended obligation crystallize; likewise the recurring half-second hesitation ('His thumb sits on the confirm key half a second too long — the same half-second he gives an unsent line to Cordon Freight's registry office') mirrors the final scene's held finger over the submission key, rewarding a reader who tracks the motif across the whole text.

checks.Title: Elevate, don't reconstruct
checks.Evidence: The excerpt shows a dense, self-referential mythology (the number, the Channeler theory, the satellite catalog, Tadesse's facility, the 'delta-actual' column, the elephant parable, the twenty-fourth invoice line) accumulating almost entirely through opaque implication and withheld referents ('them,' 'the number,' 'the source') with no onboarding scaffolding for a reader who doesn't already know the universe's rules about neuretics, CorpoNation zones, Channelers, or the Attendance incident.
checks.Fix: Add brief grounding beats early (e.g., one clarifying sentence when 'neuretics' or 'Channeler' first appears, or a line anchoring what kind of world this is) rather than trusting a first-time reader to infer the entire cosmology from context, without cutting or restructuring the existing plot machinery.

checks.Title: Orient through GLMZ's five pillars
checks.Evidence: The story systemically braids all five pillars: the AI-narrator relationship builds a genuine faction/agenda entity ('working hypothesis... this is a data observation, not a conclusion'; the unnamed CorpoNation clearance code shutting his session mid-request); nanites appear as decayed infrastructure ('the building's nanite skin ran out of contract a decade ago and stopped mending itself'); neuretics mark the social/technical divide ('the mesh grown into anyone who can afford the surgery... which he still has and the corridor under the Crow mostly doesn't'); the Schism is treated as a physics-breaking wound tied to a deep, unexplained mechanism ('the source and the resonances share a mechanism... a drain running the wrong direction'); and CorpoNations/gray zones structure the entire plot through permits, holding companies, ArcSec inquiries, and Zone 7 shell registrations that exist precisely because law can't reach them.
